# Message reference

Every OCPP message Volkai sends and answers, per version, generated from the code.

- OCPP 2.0.1: **25** messages a charger sends, **40** commands it answers (DataTransfer works both ways).
- OCPP 1.6J: **10** messages a charger sends, **19** commands it answers.

## Charger to CSMS: OCPP 2.0.1

| Message | When Volkai sends it |
|---|---|
| `Authorize` | A card is tapped (or the vehicle identifies itself with auto charge). |
| `BootNotification` | Right after connecting, after a reboot, and when triggered. |
| `ClearedChargingLimit` | A grid / energy-management limit ends (the grid_overload fault clearing). |
| `DataTransfer` | You send it from the Messages tab, or a scenario does. |
| `FirmwareStatusNotification` | At every step of a firmware update, and when triggered. |
| `Get15118EVCertificate` | You send it from the Messages tab (no real ISO 15118 exchange). |
| `GetCertificateStatus` | You send it from the Messages tab. |
| `Heartbeat` | Every HeartbeatInterval seconds, and when triggered. |
| `LogStatusNotification` | At every step of a log upload (GetLog), and when triggered. |
| `MeterValues` | Clock-aligned data, when triggered, and for a meter reading outside a transaction. |
| `NotifyChargingLimit` | A grid / energy-management limit starts (the grid_overload fault). |
| `NotifyCustomerInformation` | After a CustomerInformation request. |
| `NotifyDisplayMessages` | After a GetDisplayMessages request. |
| `NotifyEVChargingNeeds` | You send it from the Messages tab (ISO 15118 needs). |
| `NotifyEVChargingSchedule` | You send it from the Messages tab. |
| `NotifyEvent` | A fault starts or clears, a variable monitor trips, and a hardware problem is reported. |
| `NotifyMonitoringReport` | After GetMonitoringReport. |
| `NotifyReport` | After GetBaseReport / GetReport (the device model, in chunks). |
| `PublishFirmwareStatusNotification` | At every step of a PublishFirmware, and when triggered. |
| `ReportChargingProfiles` | After GetChargingProfiles. |
| `ReservationStatusUpdate` | A reservation expires. |
| `SecurityEventNotification` | Tamper detection and other security events. |
| `SignCertificate` | A CSR is sent (after the CSMS asks, or when triggered). |
| `StatusNotification` | Every connector status change, after a boot, and when triggered. |
| `TransactionEvent` | Every step of a session: Started, Updated (state, meter, trigger) and Ended. |

## CSMS to charger: OCPP 2.0.1

| Command | How Volkai answers |
|---|---|
| `CancelReservation` | Removes the reservation. Accepted if it existed, Rejected if not. |
| `CertificateSigned` | Stores the certificate chain (checks it against the pending CSR). |
| `ChangeAvailability` | Sets the station, an EVSE or a connector Operative / Inoperative. Scheduled while a session runs. |
| `ClearCache` | Empties the authorization cache. |
| `ClearChargingProfile` | Removes matching charging profiles (Accepted, or Unknown if none matched). |
| `ClearDisplayMessage` | Removes a stored display message. |
| `ClearVariableMonitoring` | Removes variable monitors by id. |
| `CostUpdated` | Stores the running cost; shown on the station display. |
| `CustomerInformation` | Answers, then sends NotifyCustomerInformation. |
| `DataTransfer` | `com.simulator.echo` echoes the data, `com.simulator.reject` is rejected, anything else is UnknownVendorId. |
| `DeleteCertificate` | Removes an installed certificate. |
| `GetBaseReport` | Answers Accepted, then sends the device model as NotifyReport. |
| `GetChargingProfiles` | Answers, then reports the matching profiles (ReportChargingProfiles). |
| `GetCompositeSchedule` | Computes the effective schedule from all installed profiles. |
| `GetDisplayMessages` | Answers, then sends NotifyDisplayMessages. |
| `GetInstalledCertificateIds` | Lists the installed certificates. |
| `GetLocalListVersion` | Returns the local authorization list version. |
| `GetLog` | Answers with a file name and runs the upload flow (LogStatusNotification). |
| `GetMonitoringReport` | Answers, then sends NotifyMonitoringReport. |
| `GetReport` | Answers, then sends the selected part of the device model. |
| `GetTransactionStatus` | Tells whether messages are queued and whether the transaction is ongoing. |
| `GetVariables` | Reads device model variables. |
| `InstallCertificate` | Stores a CA certificate. |
| `PublishFirmware` | Runs the publish flow (PublishFirmwareStatusNotification). |
| `RequestStartTransaction` | Answers Accepted, then authorizes (if AuthorizeRemoteStart) and starts when a vehicle is connected. |
| `RequestStopTransaction` | Ends the session with reason Remote. |
| `ReserveNow` | Reserves an EVSE for a token until the expiry. |
| `Reset` | Immediate or OnIdle; reboots the station (or one EVSE) with the boot reason RemoteReset. |
| `SendLocalList` | Replaces (Full) or updates (Differential) the local authorization list. |
| `SetChargingProfile` | Validates and installs the profile; the power limit changes at once. |
| `SetDisplayMessage` | Stores a message for the station display. |
| `SetMonitoringBase` | Selects the monitoring base. |
| `SetMonitoringLevel` | Sets the severity level of events. |
| `SetNetworkProfile` | Stores a network connection profile. |
| `SetVariableMonitoring` | Creates variable monitors; a trip sends NotifyEvent. |
| `SetVariables` | Writes device model variables (changes apply at once: heartbeat interval, sample interval, start points, ...). |
| `TriggerMessage` | Answers Accepted, then sends the requested message. |
| `UnlockConnector` | Unlocks the connector (UnlockFailed while the connector_lock_failure fault is active, or during a session). |
| `UnpublishFirmware` | Stops publishing a firmware image. |
| `UpdateFirmware` | Runs the full flow: Downloading, Downloaded, Installing, reboot, Installed (or a failure you armed). |

## Charger to CSMS: OCPP 1.6J

| Message | When Volkai sends it |
|---|---|
| `Authorize` | A card is tapped (or the vehicle identifies itself with auto charge). |
| `BootNotification` | Right after connecting, after a reboot, and when triggered. |
| `DataTransfer` | You send it from the Messages tab, or a scenario does. |
| `DiagnosticsStatusNotification` | At every step of a diagnostics upload (GetDiagnostics), and when triggered. |
| `FirmwareStatusNotification` | At every step of a firmware update, and when triggered. |
| `Heartbeat` | Every HeartbeatInterval seconds, and when triggered. |
| `MeterValues` | Clock-aligned data, when triggered, and for a meter reading outside a transaction. |
| `StartTransaction` | A session starts (the CSMS answers with the transaction id). |
| `StatusNotification` | Every connector status change, after a boot, and when triggered. |
| `StopTransaction` | A session ends. |

## CSMS to charger: OCPP 1.6J

| Command | How Volkai answers |
|---|---|
| `CancelReservation` | Removes the reservation. Accepted if it existed, Rejected if not. |
| `ChangeAvailability` | Sets a connector (or connector 0, the whole station) Operative / Inoperative. |
| `ChangeConfiguration` | Writes a configuration key (Accepted, Rejected for a read-only key or a bad value, NotSupported for an unknown key). |
| `ClearCache` | Empties the authorization cache. |
| `ClearChargingProfile` | Removes matching charging profiles. |
| `DataTransfer` | `com.simulator.echo` echoes the data, `com.simulator.reject` is rejected, anything else is UnknownVendorId. |
| `GetCompositeSchedule` | Computes the effective schedule from all installed profiles. |
| `GetConfiguration` | Reads configuration keys (all, or the ones asked for, with unknownKey for the rest). |
| `GetDiagnostics` | Answers with a file name and runs the upload flow (DiagnosticsStatusNotification). |
| `GetLocalListVersion` | Returns the local authorization list version (-1 when the list is disabled). |
| `RemoteStartTransaction` | Answers Accepted, then starts when a vehicle is connected (the idTag is the card id). |
| `RemoteStopTransaction` | Ends the session with reason Remote (the transactionId is the integer the CSMS gave). |
| `ReserveNow` | Reserves a connector for an idTag until the expiry. |
| `Reset` | Hard or Soft; reboots the station. |
| `SendLocalList` | Replaces (Full) or updates (Differential) the local authorization list. |
| `SetChargingProfile` | Validates and installs the profile; the power limit changes at once. |
| `TriggerMessage` | Answers Accepted, then sends BootNotification, Heartbeat, StatusNotification, MeterValues, FirmwareStatusNotification or DiagnosticsStatusNotification. |
| `UnlockConnector` | Unlocks the connector (UnlockFailed during a session or with the lock fault). |
| `UpdateFirmware` | Runs the full flow: Downloading, Downloaded, Installing, Installed (or a failure you armed). |

## What a 1.6 charger does with 2.0.1 messages

Messages that exist only in 2.0.1 (`NotifyEvent`, `SecurityEventNotification`, device model reports, display messages, monitoring, certificates, ISO 15118, ...) are quietly not sent on a 1.6 charger; a fault is reported as the `errorCode` of a `StatusNotification` instead. A `TransactionEvent` becomes `StartTransaction` / `MeterValues` / `StopTransaction`. See [Connect and versions](../01-connect-and-versions.md).

## Rule effects

Outgoing messages: `corrupt`, `delay`, `drop`, `duplicate`. Incoming commands: `delay`, `error`, `invalid_response`, `reject`, `timeout`. CALLERROR codes you can inject: `NotImplemented`, `NotSupported`, `InternalError`, `ProtocolError`, `SecurityError`, `FormationViolation`, `PropertyConstraintViolation`, `OccurenceConstraintViolation`, `TypeConstraintViolation`, `GenericError`. See [Message rules](../05-message-rules.md).
